title: 3 Undervalued Healthcare Stocks Invstors Can Buy Right Now
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; captions readable, some auto-caption garbling of numbers
summary: Parkevtate frames US healthcare as disrupted by administration pricing pressure — pushing consumers to pay their own way and pressing pharma/healthcare companies to lower prices in exchange for reduced tariffs — creating stock-picking opportunities and risks. Three DCF-based BUY calls. TDOC (Teladoc Health): BUY at $6.13 (fair value $7.86, ~30% upside over 12-18 months); pandemic boom then plateau, revenue peaked with one segment declining ~20%; long-term telehealth substitution tailwind as management cuts ad spend and improves provider availability. LLY (Eli Lilly): BUY (fair value $1,494, ~30% upside); weight-loss demand surge likened to the AI boom; free cash flow estimated growing $12B (2025) to over $77B by 2032; robust pipeline over decades; he owns it and is adding; bear case is administration drug-pricing pressure. This reaffirms his 26 Sep LLY BUY — no flip. OSCR (Oscar Health): BUY (fair value above $41/share, >34% upside); one of the best at incorporating AI for efficiency; fastest-growing US health company since 2024 with >20% forecast revenue CAGR through 2030 and improving profits; bear case is that policy disruption cuts both ways. He adds that healthcare spending is non-cyclical, giving investors macro diversification. Also announces his book on his six-step investing framework.
